correctness.rationale: The source-free stationary OU ODE yields \(p\prime\prime=(r-\kappa)p/D\) wherever \(p\prime=0\), in particular \(p\prime\prime(0)=(r-\kappa)p(0)/D\). Strict positivity forces derivative-sign rigidity on the central gap. The two delta masses yield the exact derivative jump and decay at infinity rules out additional external turning points; \(r=\kappa\) gives the explicitly normalized plateau. Independent renewal-age integrals and the exact second moment agree in 33 deterministic parameter checks. These checks do not replace the proof.
